mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC >0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% triggers a labor market tightening effect, reducing equity risk premium expectations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns are negative despite UNRATE crossing below 4.0%, or t-test p >0.05 showing no significant effect.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous upward trend in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) signals robust demand growth, amplifying equity valuation multiples and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns are negative when both proxies trend upward, or IC <0.03 over 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, sustained increases in the federal funds rate reduce equity risk premium expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur in >50% of tightening cycles, or IC >0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below 100 signals weakening supply-side growth, prompting equity investors to anticipate higher inflation and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns are negative when INDPRO falls below 100, or t-test p>0.05 showing no effect.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in unemployment (UNRATE) and rising jobless claims (PAYEMS) indicate a labor market contraction, reducing equity risk premium expectations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns are negative when UNRATE falls while PAYEMS rises, or IC <0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) reflects robust demand growth, leading to higher corporate earnings estimates and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns are negative despite upward GDPC1 trend, or IC >0.03 over 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, sustained increases in the federal funds rate signal policy tightening, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur in >40% of late-cycle expansions, or IC >0.03 over 3-year window.
